card.line: Gath was one of the five royal Philistine cities and the home of the giant Goliath. It is where the ark brought trouble and where David hid from Saul.

moments.title: The ark sent to Gath
moments.text: The Philistines of Ashdod moved the ark of the God of Israel to Gath. The LORD's hand was against that city, and its people, young and old, were struck with tumors.

moments.title: David pretends to be mad
moments.text: David ran from Saul to Achish, king of Gath. Afraid when Achish's servants spoke of his victories, David acted insane, and Achish wanted nothing to do with him.

moments.title: David lives in Gath
moments.text: David went to Achish with his six hundred men and their families, and they settled in Gath. When Saul heard David was there, he stopped searching for him.

moments.title: A giant killed at Gath
moments.text: In a battle at Gath, a huge man with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot taunted Israel. Jonathan, David's nephew, killed him.

moments.title: Shimei goes to Gath
moments.text: Shimei had been told by Solomon never to leave Jerusalem. When his slaves ran away to Gath, he went there to bring them back, and so broke the king's command.
